policy.scope: Publicly accessible preschool, childcare, kindergarten and school events within the requested approximately 45-minute discovery area; prioritize child participation around age 3.
include: Public family festivals, seasonal celebrations, performances, fairs and hands-on workshops
Open houses, playdates and trial sessions explicitly welcoming prospective families and children; label admissions/recruitment purpose
exclude: Parent-teacher conferences, routine school days, closures and enrollment deadlines
Adults-only admissions information sessions as child outings
policy.publicAccessEvidenceRule: A publicly readable school calendar alone does not establish public admission. Verify event-specific outsider/prospective-family eligibility using official event text, flyer or registration page. Unknown eligibility stays in review.
policy.ageEvidenceRule: A school serving age 3 does not prove every event accepts age 3. Record event-specific ages separately; keep unconfirmed age suitability in review.
requiredChecks: event age limits and child participation
registration, price, residency and enrollment restrictions
policy.deduplicationRule: Deduplicate school-hosted and municipal/PTA-promoted copies of the same event using date, time, venue and event identity.
